cli.goal: Add server-backed decision registration, export and compact preview commands
cli.instructions: Own CLI tree/handlers, decision HTTP client and renderers. Default latest one task; support --tasks N, --all and repeated --task-id with exclusive parsing. Stream lossless JSON/Markdown export; file publication atomic, no overwrite without --force. Preview plain text/JSON with sanitization and Unicode budgets. Preserve stdout machine content, diagnostics stderr; no SQLite access. Report real-server CLI fixtures, interrupted output and selector parity evidence.

acceptance_criteria.statement: CLI default/N/all/explicit selection matches backend; empty/latest/concurrent cases are deterministic; interrupted files are not published and nonzero exit is returned.

migration.goal: Provide explicit Semantica import and graph-aware repair refusal/deletion
migration.instructions: Own import preview/apply service, HTTP/CLI wiring, source fixtures and project repair/deletion integration. Dry run first; require mapping, source digest and revision for apply. Preserve unknown raw payload and task mapping, refuse unresolved causal endpoints, replay namespace/external IDs without overwrite. Project repair must refuse before any mutation whenever a retired project has graph rows, including two nonempty graphs; graph-free losers can fold without changing winner graph. Do not merge graph order/revision/replay namespaces. Delete owned graph FK-safely; backup/rekey retain graph. Reject implicit accepted statuses and direct file-to-SQL writes. Report fixture counts, preflight refusal/rollback and rekey/restart evidence.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Dry run writes nothing; apply atomic/replay-safe; raw source preserved; occupied retired graphs block repair without changes; deletion and rekey handle complete graph.
acceptance_criteria.check: DecisionImport_DryRunReplayAndUnknownData; DecisionRepair_TwoGraphsRefused; DecisionRepair_FoldAndConflictReport; encrypted backup/rekey and deletion fixtures

Delegate review-tests to reviewer only; retain mutation evidence. Keep external ai-badger framework switch a separate coordinated PR after gates. Document rollback matching binary/bank backup and legacy config. Report CI/reviews and exact release version; no auto-disable Semantica before acceptance.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Cross-surface behavior persists after restart, access modes agree, test quality is independently reviewed, release is traceable, and handover/rollback are documented.
